title: Up to 32% Off on Exterior & Interior Car Detail at Cobbs Detailing
description:
What We Offer:
Full Exterior Car Detail
Full Interior Car Detail
Full Car Detail (Interior and Exterior)
Every surface is carefully cleaned using professional-grade tools like soft-bristle brushes, microfiber towels, upholstery and leather cleaners, and protectants that leave seats, dashboards, and panels refreshed. Even those hard-to-reach areas are handled with precision using an air compressor to remove hidden dust and debris.
For those who want to refresh the outside, the exterior detail focuses on restoring or exceeding the original condition of the cars finish. From the glossy paint to the chrome trim, glass, wheels, and tires, every visible surface is polished to perfection. The service not only cleans but protects, leaving your car shining and safeguarded against the elements.
Drivers looking for the ultimate treatment can opt for the complete interior and exterior detail, a comprehensive package that combines both services into one transformative experience. This option ensures that every inch of the car, inside and out, looks its very best.

faqs.question: What detail package options are available at Cobbs Detailing?
faqs.answer: This deal offers three options: a Full Exterior Car Detail, a Full Interior Car Detail, or a Full Car Detail covering both Interior and Exterior. Buyers can choose the option that best suits their vehicle's needs.

faqs.question: Does Cobbs Detailing offer a combined interior and exterior car detail?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cobbs Detailing offers a Full Car Detail option that covers both the interior and exterior of the vehicle. This is in addition to the standalone Full Exterior Car Detail and Full Interior Car Detail options.

faqs.question: Where is the Exterior & Interior Car Detail at Cobbs Detailing redeemed?
faqs.answer: This deal is redeemed at Cobbs Detailing's location on Blue Hill Ave in Boston, MA 02126.

faqs.question: Can I get just an exterior detail at Cobbs Detailing, or is an interior detail required?
faqs.answer: Cobbs Detailing offers a standalone Full Exterior Car Detail option, so customers are not required to include an interior detail. Alternatively, a Full Interior Car Detail or a combined Full Car Detail is also available.

faqs.question: What category of service does the Exterior & Interior Car Detail at Cobbs Detailing fall under?
faqs.answer: This deal falls under the Automotive category, specifically Auto Cleaning and Auto Detailing. Cobbs Detailing provides professional auto detailing services at their Boston, MA location.
